desc: Correct conflict rules: shared left endpoint (any types), shared right endpoint (any types), same-type proper crossing; touching/nesting/opposite-type crossing compatible
Replace bad[]+RMQ plan with two-pointer + existence-only conflict check; query [L,R] = Yes iff R <= limit[L]
Implement segment trees (per type: min-tree over r-coords, max-tree over l-coords) with point updates; cntL/cntR uniqueness collapses heaps to single values
Implement main loop: fast IO, compression, two pointers, O(1) queries
Hand-verify against both samples (Yes,No and No,Yes,Yes match)

STRESS TEST against Bellman-Ford brute force: exhaustive all-subsets validation for N=3,4,5, targeted pair batteries for N=3..6, and 20000 random tests — all passed, confirming the corrected pairwise-conflict characterization and pairwise<=>global sufficiency
Performance/memory assessment: algorithm is O(M log M + Q) with iterative segment trees and freed input buffer (~50MB), appropriate for N≤4e5, M,Q≤2e5; no further changes needed
